Cheats for Super Metroid DS

Put RetroArch cheat files (.cht) here, for instance the Super Metroid ones
from the libretro database:
  https://github.com/libretro/libretro-database/tree/master/cht/Nintendo%20-%20Super%20Nintendo%20Entertainment%20System
Every .cht in this folder (and in folders inside it) is read, all in one list.

In the game: HOME (or TAP FOR SETTINGS) -> Game -> Cheats. Each cheat has
ON / OFF: D-pad and A, L / R a page at a time, B back; or tap a cheat to
switch it, drag to scroll. Choices take effect at once and are remembered
(states/<game>.cheats); a file's own cheatN_enable values count until you
change something.

Codes: Pro Action Replay (7E09C2DB), Game Genie (C288-C5A7) and 7E09C2:DB,
several joined with '+'.

Cheats can crash or soft-lock the game, and what they change is kept in
your saves: make a save state first.
